title: Introduce prompt siloing and hierarchical rollback gate
author: Aisha Menon
description: Motivation: production runs have exposed situations where a single broad regression in a prompt set can cascade into unrelated cohorts and cause noisy CI failures. This PR introduces a two-part mechanism: (1) prompt siloing, which partitions prompt sets into isolation groups by semantic cluster and traffic footprint, and (2) a hierarchical rollback gate that enforces progressive remediation: local cohort quarantine -> silo-level rollback -> global hold. The goal is to reduce blast radius for prompt-set regressions while keeping the CI signal actionable. Changes: implement prompt_siloer that computes deterministic silo IDs from prompt vectors and metadata; add hierarchical_gate middleware that tracks staggered failure counts and applies graduated holdback policies; expose new CI hook endpoints for gated decisions and escalation logs; add end-to-end integration tests and a smoke job for canary sampling. Checklist: - [x] unit tests for silo assignment and gate thresholds - [x] integration tests for staged rollback behavior - [x] docs + quickstart snippet for SREs - [x] Linear link in PR body Related: linear ENG-2143 (silo sampling) and ENG-2201 (rollback UX). Impact: opt-in by default for new prompt sets, configurable via eval-harness config under "gating.silos"; backward compatible with existing CI pipelines. Rollout plan: stage behind feature flag, enable for 10% of prompt traffic in canary, watch stability index and false-positive rate for two weeks before broad enablement.

release_notes: Adds a configurable prompt siloing component and a hierarchical rollback gate for eval CI. Opt-in via gating.silos.{enabled,min_silo_qps,escalation_thresholds}. Improves CI signal-to-noise and reduces global regressions. See docs/gating.md for configuration and rollout guidance.
notes_for_oncall: Feature is behind feature flag gating.silos.enabled default false. If you see unexpected bulk rollbacks, disable the flag and inspect silo_rollback_escalations_total{reason=...}. Canary pipelines created at ci/pipelines/canary_gating.yml.
additional_context: Design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2143/prompt-siloing-design. The approach favors conservative escalation; thresholds are deliberately tunable per-customer. This PR was developed alongside SRE and Platform to ensure rollout safety.
